name: Full Regression Test Suite
description: Master regression suite orchestrating all critical feature tests: Captain Z enforcement, FedSpace MSL asset denial, Cluster Generation v2 invariants, Police Phase A/B/C/D1, Ferengi NPC initialization, and TLS transport.

features_covered: S2S peer registry, authentication handshake, and replay protection (Issue #223)
FedSpace MSL asset deployment denial (deny in 1-10, destroy in >10)
Police Phase A: RPC availability and jurisdiction stubs
Police Phase B: Incident state tracking (suspicion/wanted_level) and port robbery trigger
Police Phase C: Resolution mechanics (bribery success/failure, surrender outcomes) and ban enforcement
Police Phase D1: Crime triggers (ATTACK_PORT, CONTRABAND), dock intercept enforcement gate, police.status RPC, lawless invariant
Phase 1: Ship Cargo - Dynamic commodity storage via normalized ship_cargo table (no schema changes for new commodities)
Phase 2: Commodities Data-Driven - Port trading and planet deposits driven by port_trade/planet_goods database entries (no code changes for new commodities)
Phase 3: Port Dynamic Trading - All port trade validation commodity-driven; adding commodity to DB/port_trade enables trading without code recompilation
prerequisites: Server running and accessible at configured host:port
